name: Greece

train.sum: Larissis station is the main hub for intercity trains to Thessaloniki. The Proastiakos suburban railway links the airport and Piraeus.
train.sched: Proastiakos runs from early morning to late evening. Check the Hellenic Train timetable.
tickets: Athens to Thessaloniki: book ahead for cheaper fares
Buy tickets online or at the station
train.tip: Check strike notices. Rail strikes are common and announced in advance.
buy: Hellenic Train website and app sell all train tickets, as e-tickets.
Ticket office at Athens (Larissis) station. Many small stations no longer have one.
Phone sales: Hellenic Train customer service, 14511.
Suburban rail (Proastiakos): ticket machines and booths at the stations. The airport ticket costs about 9 EUR.
On board: the conductor sells tickets only if your station has no open ticket office. Otherwise buy before boarding.

destinations.note: Ancient Corinth is 8 km away. Take a local bus or taxi
Gateway to Evia. The train crosses the bridge
End of the Peloponnese suburban line. Change here for Aigio
About 2 trains a day. Check for line works
About 2 trains a day (06:58 and 17:58 in Nov 2026). Line works in 2026 caused closures and bus replacements, so check before you book
Two direct trains a day. Other trains need a change at Paleofarsalos

tram.sum: The Athens metro has 3 lines (M1 to M3). Tram T6 runs from Syntagma to the coast at Pikrodafni. Tram T7 runs along the coast from Piraeus to Voula, via Glyfada.
tram.sched: Metro about 05:30 to 00:30. Lines 2 and 3 run to about 02:00 on Friday and all night on Saturday. Tram also runs all night on Saturday.
tickets: 3-day tourist ticket with one airport trip: about 20 EUR
tram.tip: Validate your ticket in the machine at the metro entrance.
buy: Tap a contactless bank card, phone or watch at metro gates and tram validators (Tap2Ride). A tap is a 90-minute ticket, about 1.20 EUR.
Ticket machines in every metro station. They take cash and cards and have an English menu.
Ticket offices in larger metro stations sell all tickets and the ATH.ENA Card.
About 550 kiosks (periptera) and mini-markets sell ATH.ENA tickets.
ATH.ENA Go app: on Android you can use the phone as a ticket. On iPhone it only reloads a card.
Not possible to buy on board the tram. Buy before boarding or tap a bank card.

bus.sum: OASA buses and trolleybuses cover the city. Express bus X95 runs between Syntagma and the airport.
bus.sched: Day buses 05:00 to 00:30. X95 operates 24 hours.
tickets: Ferries from Piraeus to the islands
bus.tip: A 90-minute ticket covers bus, tram and metro for the whole period.
buy: Tap a contactless bank card, phone or watch on the reader on board.
Buy ATH.ENA tickets before boarding at metro station machines, ticket offices or kiosks.
Drivers on city buses and trolleys do not sell tickets. Do not count on buying on board.
Validate a paper ticket in the machine inside the bus.

airport.sum: Athens International (ATH) is east of the city, about 40 minutes by metro.
airport.sched: Metro line 3 takes about 40 minutes to Syntagma.
tickets: Metro line 3 / airport ticket: about 9 EUR
airport.tip: Taxi fares to the centre are fixed. Night fare applies from midnight to 05:00.
buy: Metro line 3 and suburban rail: ticket machines and booths at the airport station. Ticket about 9 EUR.
A contactless bank card works at the metro gates, but it is charged the airport fare, about 9 EUR.
Express buses X93, X95, X96 and X97: ticket booth outside Arrivals, between exits 4 and 5. About 5.50 EUR.
On board the express buses you can tap a contactless bank card. Do not count on buying a paper ticket from the driver.

metro.note: Three metro lines: M1 (green), M2 (red) and M3 (blue). The airport is on M3.
metro.mapLabel: Find the metro map on the OASA site
lines: M3 (Blue): Dimotiko Theatro to the airport
Syntagma links M2 and M3, Monastiraki links M1 and M3, Omonia and Attiki link M1 and M2

tips: Validate your ticket in the machine at the metro entrance.
Strikes can stop the metro and buses, so check before you travel.
In summer, book island ferries from Piraeus in advance.
The fine without a valid, validated ticket is 100 EUR (50 EUR if you qualify for a reduced fare), in force since 30 May 2026.
